core_routines.name: resolve_and_init_room
core_routines.description: Clears room/area state on change, resolves descriptor via 0x00C92C, sets $FF16EC, jumps to +0x1A(a1)

core_routines.name: lookup_room_descriptor
core_routines.description: Pure lookup of room descriptor pointer a0 from room_id d0=(area<<8)|room via 0x00C92C

core_routines.name: dispatch_room_post_vblank
core_routines.description: If $FF17B8 bit 1 clear, dispatches to room post-VBlank handler at a1 + word(0(a1))

core_routines.name: dispatch_room_pre_vblank_tick
core_routines.description: If $FF17B8 bit 1 clear, dispatches to room pre-VBlank tick handler at (a1+2) + word(2(a1))

core_routines.name: check_room_exit_locks
core_routines.description: Checks 6 lock flags ($FF17B9,$FF1987,$FF1985,$FF17B8:2,$FF1983,$FF1982); pops caller return if locked

core_routines.name: check_player_tile_aabb
core_routines.description: Tests player ($FF19E8) +/- radius $46(a0) against 8x8 tile AABB [d1*8, d2*8+7]; sets Carry on hit

core_routines.name: transition_entry_param_fade
core_routines.description: Sets $FF19FE=d5, $FF17BE=0xFF, computes cam=(px-160,py-112), enters common transition loader 0x00CA3E

core_routines.name: transition_entry_fade_spawn
core_routines.description: Computes cam=(d3-160,d4-112), packs d3=(px<<16)|py, clears $FF17BE, enters 0x00CA3E

core_routines.name: transition_entry_seamless_scroll
core_routines.description: Clears $FF17BE, remaps room 0x0004->0x0611, stops BGM (cmd 2), saves d1-d3 to $FF1782, runs fade/DMA sync

core_routines.name: transition_reset_player_and_spirit
core_routines.description: Clears entities via 0x008C5A, resets player ($FF19E8) and spirit ($FF1AA4) positions/velocities

core_routines.name: transition_load_room_and_spawns
core_routines.description: Resolves spawn script $FF17B2 via 0x04371E, calls 0x00C8AA, 0x00F788, 0x00C980, 0x008E90, 0x00A196, starts BGM

core_routines.name: load_room_resources_and_tilemaps
core_routines.description: Copies room header to $FF16F0..$FF170E, decompresses 4 tile banks + map stream via 0x003820, runs 0x00F80E

core_routines.name: step_room_spawn_script_vm
core_routines.description: Main per-frame bytecode interpreter reading $FF17B2 and dispatching 33 opcodes via 0x00F7D0

core_routines.name: preload_room_spawn_script_vm
core_routines.description: Room-load pre-pass executing leading opcodes 0x0A (VRAM DMA), 0x12 (branch), 0x13 (call), 0x14 (ret)

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_YIELD_HALT
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Pops interpreter return address and halts script at current PC

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_SPAWN_RANDOM_ENEMY
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Spawns enemy if active count < $FF17B7; allocates slot via 0x00DA2A

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_LOAD_DROP_TABLE
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Loads word stream into $FF17C6 until 0xFFFF

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_LOAD_PAIR_TABLE
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Loads coordinate/param pairs into $FF17E6 until 0xFFFF

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_WAIT_CONDITION
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Yields until enemy count, flag ($FF0DBC/$FF0E1C/$FF0E2C), or player/spirit coord matches

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_JUMP_REL16
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Adds signed 16-bit offset at +2(a0) to script PC a0

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_DEC_COUNTER_BRANCH
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Decrements counter $FF1826[idx] and branches by +2(a0) if non-zero

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_SET_COUNTER
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Sets loop counter $FF1826[idx] = word

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_WAIT_FRAMES
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Sets wait timer $FF17B6 = byte and yields

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_SET_CAMERA_LOCK
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Updates camera boundary/lock state

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_PRELOAD_NEMESIS_DMA
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Decompresses ROM stream at +2(a0) via 0x00D9A4/0x003820 and queues VRAM DMA to +6(a0)

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_SET_MAX_ENEMIES
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Sets $FF17B7 = max concurrent enemy threshold

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_STAGE_PALETTE
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Copies 16-color palette from 0x05D046 + idx*32 to $FF136C

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_UPLOAD_PALETTE_DMA
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Copies palette from 0x05D046 + idx*32 to $FF136C and sets $FF164D bit 0

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_SPAWN_FIXED_ENEMY
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Spawns fixed-coord enemy if count < $FF17B7 via 0x00DA2A & 0x0102BE

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_MOD_GLOBAL_FLAG
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Sets/clears/toggles bit in global flag table $FF0DBC

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_MOD_AREA_FLAG
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Sets/clears/toggles bit in area flag table $FF0E1C

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_MOD_ROOM_FLAG
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Sets/clears/toggles bit in room flag table $FF0E2C

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_BRANCH_IF_CONDITION
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Conditional relative branch on flags, enemy counts, or coordinates

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_CALL_SUBSCRIPT
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Saves return PC to $FF1836 and jumps to 24-bit script address

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_RET_SUBSCRIPT
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Restores script PC a0 from $FF1836

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_SPAWN_GATED_PROP
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Spawns chest/prop/archway if flag bit clear; allocates slot via 0x00DA2A

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_SPAWN_PROP_UNCOND
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Unconditionally spawns prop/interactive object via 0x00DA2A

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_SPAWN_LINKED_PAIR
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Spawns linked entity pair 0x0072 + 0x0070 via 0x00DA2A

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_SPAWN_NPC_A
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Spawns scripted NPC/actor variant A

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_SPAWN_NPC_B
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Spawns scripted NPC/actor variant B

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_PLAY_SPATIAL_SFX
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Dispatches spatial sound command via 0x00E78E

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_PLAY_SOUND_CMD
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Dispatches direct sound command via 0x060004

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_SET_FF17C4
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Writes 16-bit parameter to $FF17C4

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_PATCH_TILEMAP
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Applies metatile patch to Plane A/B via 0x00DB64/0x00DB68/0x00DBCA

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_AUTO_WALK_PLAYER
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Locks input ($FF1982) and auto-walks player ($FF17BD ticks, dir $FF183A, speed $FF183C)

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_RESERVED_1F
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Unused/reserved table slot

spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.name: VM_RUN_PRELOAD_PASS
spawn_vm_opcodes_00f7d0.description: Invokes preload filter 0x00F80E
